context.title: Fractions, units and necessary conditions

indices.title: Fractions, Units and Necessary Conditions
topics: Selected equal parts of the same whole
Denominator as unit; numerator as count
Equivalent fractions through multiplying by the same positive integer
Adding fractions by choosing a common unit
conditions: Fractions must refer to the same whole before their quantities can be compared.
Multiplying both numerator and denominator by the same positive integer changes the partition without changing the quantity.
To add 1/2 and 1/3 of the same whole, use sixths: 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6.
quotes: A fraction describes selected equal parts of the same whole.
Equivalent fractions represent the same quantity: multiplying both numerator and denominator by the same positive integer changes the partition without changing the quantity.
